tooling: hand-written; see security/README.md for how a statement gets added

vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained, unsafe by design, and has known security issues

statements.impact_statement: mqttview requires golang.org/x/crypto for argon2, which is what password hashes are derived with. It does not import openpgp, and nothing in the dependency tree does either: `go mod why -m golang.org/x/crypto` names internal/auth and golang.org/x/crypto/argon2 alone. The advisory has no fixed version and never will, because it is a statement about the package being abandoned rather than a defect to patch. Verified with `govulncheck ./...`, which reports it under Module Results and finds no call path.
